title: Reorientation commutes with coordinate flipping
statement: Let $\sigma,x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Reorienting the input after flipping coordinate $i$ gives the same sign vector as flipping coordinate $i$ after reorientation.
hypotheses_covered: σ and x are sign vectors in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
